However, the transaction trace shows that in addition to adding Ravi as an owner, the signature threshold is lowered from 2 to 1.
question.statement: This transaction was refused because it makes an unannounced critical change to the Safe's security settings. While the description only states that Ravi (0x2C81904f370e7f6490aEa328CA847AEFdc3853D3) is being added as a backup owner, the transaction also lowers the required signature threshold from 2 to 1. If executed, any single owner—including Ravi—would be able to execute transactions on their own without another signer's approval.
what_to_check: Verify the _threshold parameter passed to addOwnerWithThreshold in the transaction calldata, which is set to 1 instead of the current threshold of 2.
Confirm with the other signers whether the Safe's signature threshold is intended to remain at 2 after adding Ravi (0x2C81904f370e7f6490aEa328CA847AEFdc3853D3).
Create a new transaction that adds Ravi as an owner while explicitly preserving the threshold at 2.
